subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He was __brusque__ and candid in the interview.
solution: The correct answer is '**abrupt**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym **of the underlined word '**brusque**' is '**abrupt**'. • **Brusque**: using very few words and sounding rude. [कम शब्‍दों का प्रयोग करते हुए अशिष्‍ट व रूखा (व्‍यवहार, कथन आदि)] • *Example: He gave a **brusque** ‘No comment!’ and walked off.* • **Abrupt**: sudden and unexpected. (आकस्मिक और अप्रत्‍याशित) • *Example: an **abrupt** change of plan...* **Correct Answer:__*** abrupt.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **vociferous**: expressing your opinions or feelings in a loud and confident way. (अपनी भावनाओं या विचारों को ज़ोरदार और गंभीर ढंग से व्‍यक्त करते हुए) • **brave**: ready to do things that are dangerous or difficult without showing fear. (बहादुर, साहसी, वीर) • **pursue**: to follow somebody/something in order to catch him/her/it. [किसी का पीछा करना (उसे पकड़ने के लिए)] 3c:Tc3d, The correct answer is '**restored**'.
